assigned.title: Corrective: production rights-invariant breach in the watch route
assigned.acceptance: The watch route serves no fabricated rights basis outside a non-deployment environment, and only one fixture provider exists; the environment classification is an allowlist expressed once and shared rather than restated; docs/E2E.md no longer blesses the divergence that produced the breach; the two affected Playwright specs assert the corrected behaviour and are EXECUTED in both production and development modes rather than only typechecked
